column5: Crash point IS server-authoritative on both live rails (no integrity issue) and _shared/crash.ts is the best-engineered game module in the repo. THREE live money defects anyway. ★1 THE LIVE SKAI RAIL RUNS 1% EDGE, NOT 5%: migration 20260623222021 deliberately set v_house_edge=0.05, then 20260722140000 - a pgcrypto schema-qualifying FIX - did a full CREATE OR REPLACE carrying an older body with 0.01, under a header claiming "the provably-fair math is UNCHANGED". Nothing since restores it. ~4 points of hold given away per SKAI bet up to MAX_CRASH_BET=10000. See recurring-issues 276. ★2 POINTS CRASH PAYS displayed^0.4: client hardcodes exp(0.15*s) (crashLiveRoundService.ts:725) while the POINTS server settles exp(0.06*s) (_shared/crash.ts:116). Displayed 2.00x pays 1.32x; displayed 100x pays 6.31x - a 15.8x gap. The client also reads the SHARED round multiplier, never the POINTS round own startedAt, and the server returns growthK that nothing consumes. ★3 POINTS stakes are silently FORFEIT when the unrelated shared round crashes - stake escrowed, no settle, no seed reveal, and crashSettleAbandoned is imported by nothing in production
